**Co-President and Treasurer of the Spanish and Portuguese Graduate Student Association (SpanPort GSA)** <br> [Rutgers University (2024-present)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Representing the Spanish and Portuguese Graduate Student Association at university meetings, serving as liaison between the graduate students and the university.</li>

<li>Planing and overseeing academic and cultural events, workshops, and seminars to foster community engagement.</li>

<li>Creating opportunities for networking and collaboration among graduate students.</li>

<li>Managing the association's budget and allocating funds to events, projects, and initiatives.</li>

<li>Maintaining accurate records of expenses and financial reports.</li>

<li>Collaborating with fellow officers and committee members to achieve GSA goals.</li>

<li>Promoting events and initiatives within the graduate student community and beyond, using platforms such as GetINVOLVED.</li>

<br>

</ul>

<li>Providing English &harr; Spanish interpretation services to support bilingual communication needs.</li>

<ul style="list-style-type: circle;">
  <li>"Exploring Language Attitudes"</li>
  <li>"What does a (socio)linguist do?"</li>
  <li>"Dual Immersion Schools and Bilingualism"</li>
  <li>"Parent Advocacy"</li>
</ul>

<li>Conducted a workshop on teaching languages to newcomers for the Board of Education Department in North Brunswick, NJ</li>

**President of METÁFORA: Arte, performance y creación en español** <br> [Rutgers University (2023-2024)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Organized and planned 8 creative workshops and interdisciplinary events celebrating Hispanic, Portuguese, and Luso-Brazilian arts and cultures, to which 80+ people attended.</li>

<li>Collaborated with faculty, guest speakers, fellow students, and other organizations ([RU Bilingual](https://rubilingual.weebly.com/) and [Literary Studies in Spanish Organization](https://rutgers.campuslabs.com/engage/organization/lsso) to provide hands-on workshops and meaningful cultural experiences.</li>

<li>Managed the SpanPort Department Grant for Developing Cultural Projects (2022-2024), overseeing a budget of \$500 to support materials and food expenses for workshops and events.</li>

<li>Coordinated logistics for all events, including room bookings, material preparation, food arrangements, and outreach to ensure smooth execution and engaging experiences.</li>

<li>Designed promotional materials and promoted events through marketing efforts in order to enhance visibility and grew event awareness within the Rutgers community.</li>

**Spanish Instructor** <br> [Servei Solidari, Spain (2019-2020)]{style="font-size: 15px; color: #adb5bd; "} <br>

<li>Taught Spanish to immigrants and refugees at A1.1 to A2.2 levels (CEFR), preparing students for the Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera (A2 citizenship exam).</li>

<li>Developed and adapted course materials based on students' needs, interests, and the foundation's objectives.</li>

<li>Fostered a multicultural and multilingual learning environment to enhance student engagement and success.</li>

<li>Applied Cooperative Learning Strategies (e.g., Kagan, Slavin) and studied their impact on this demographic.</li>

<li>Delivered online training to volunteer teachers on Cooperative Learning methods and their application in language classrooms, focusing on strategies for Spanish as a Foreign and a Second Language.</li>

<li>Presented practical applications based on my research in Cooperative Learning and classroom experiences from my master's thesis and language teaching background.</li>
